title: Inspect X API rate-window and page-budget representation

findings.evidence: retrySeconds reads x-rate-limit-reset only when retry-after is absent; rg under packages/connector-x/test has zero x-rate-limit matches; XApiFixture 429 always sets retry-after (src/api/testkit.ts:42).
findings.invariant: GET 429 cooldown must be determined from untrusted headers with the documented local clamp.
findings.required_follow_up: Add the seven proposed_new rows from rate-window-cases.json to client.test.ts via the exported request() seam. Do not duplicate client.test.ts:74-84 retry-after cases.

findings.evidence: A present retry-after that is not all-digits and not a round-tripped 29-char IMF-fixdate returns 60 before L42.
findings.required_follow_up: Characterize in tests. Do not silently invert precedence; official docs (2026-09-06) recommend x-rate-limit-reset and do not mention Retry-After.

findings.evidence: bounded() is Math.max(1, Math.min(86400, seconds)). Official rate-limits.md sample (fetched 2026-09-06) uses max(reset-now, 60).
findings.invariant: Local automatic delay is a scheduling rule, not the provider reset (API.md:135-140).
findings.required_follow_up: Keep the local clamp explicit. Do not treat a 1s retry_at as proof the provider window elapsed.

findings.evidence: Only retry-after and x-rate-limit-reset are consulted, and only on status 429 (client.ts:97-99). Official headers x-rate-limit-limit and x-rate-limit-remaining (docs.x.com 2026-09-06) are unused. A 200 with remaining 0 does not pause.
findings.invariant: Progress reporting cannot include remaining/limit. Wave1 paused_until-on-remaining-0 is not current code.
findings.required_follow_up: P063/P064 must not add remaining-0 pause tests against this revision. Consuming those headers is a later contract change.

findings.evidence: coverageDetail emits available window drained vs continuation pending. Health detail is static coverage. Future retry_at gates run() with zero GETs and returns unavailable with the previous cursor. Numeric remaining/reset/pages-left are not in SyncBatch.detail.
findings.invariant: RFC 0002 E11 tri-state: unavailable is not emptiness; checkpoint does not advance.
findings.required_follow_up: Treat pages 0..64, max_results=100, and 5-request/45s budget as local page/operation budgets, distinct from the provider 15-minute window.

source_references.note: Headers x-rate-limit-limit/remaining/reset; 429 recovery via reset; no Retry-After mention; user /2/users/:id/tweets 900/15min; /2/users/me 75/15min.
